Category.name: Other Rituals
Category.description: Moon cycles, intentions and symbolic rites.

Ritual.name: Area Protection for 47 Days
Ritual.description: By chanting this mantra you can protect any area around you within 2 minutes. No negative energy, wild animals and danger situations will been entered within that area for 47 days.

Ritual.name: REMOVE NEGATIVE ENERGY
Ritual.description: Cut any Tantra kriya like Mohini, Vashikaran, Maran, Ucchatan, Bideshan anything like this.

Ritual.name: Ultimate Health, Wealth & Success
Ritual.description: Transform your life with this powerful Siddha Bengali Mantra. Chant it daily to attract supreme physical energy, sharp intellect, divine blessings of Goddess Lakshmi and Saraswati, and ultimate health, wealth, and prosperity.

Ritual.name: BIND ANYONE's HOUSE
Ritual.description: Mantra to bind someone's house while sitting far away.

Ritual.name: BODY PROTECTION 7.5 DAYS
Ritual.description: This ritualistic chant functions as a sacred spiritual shield designed to bind and protect an individual's physical body from negative energies, malevolent spirits, and occult harms for exactly seven and a half days.

Ritual.name: Half-Headache Relief
Ritual.description: The mantra is a plea to various deities like Dhanvantari (the god of medicine), Mahadev (Shiva), Baidyanath, and Narayan, as well as Goddess Kamakhya, to remove physical and half-headaches, free the 'head's vein currents', and eliminate any negative 'tantra' or 'mantra' effects in the body. The text uses a mixture of Hindi-script spellings for Bengali words.

Ritual.name: INCREASE MILK PRODUCTION
Ritual.description: Increase the milk production of any animal like - cow, goat, buffalo etc.

Ritual.name: PITRA DOSH REMOVAL
Ritual.description: By known or dont you may have Pitra Dosh so that you are not getting the exact cost of your effort by chanting this mantra can remove the PITRA DOSH from your life so that you can achieve your dreamy destination.

Ritual.name: PAIN KILLER RITUAL
Ritual.description: THIS RITUAL WILL REMOVE ANY TYPE OF PAIN FROM YOUR BODY IMMEDIATELY.

Ritual.name: Feel Energetic The Whole Day
Ritual.description: Feel Energetic The Whole Day, Its a Ritual designed to change your lifestyle completely in 365 Days 100% GURENTEED.

Ritual.name: Rekindling Connection Meditation
Ritual.description: A meditative practice to reconnect with yourself or a loved one through gentle reflection.
Ritual.source: Guided meditative practice. No historical provenance; reflective and intention-based.

Ritual.name: Mahamrityunjaya Healing Mantra
Ritual.description: A meditative chant traditionally associated with healing, protection and inner strength.
Ritual.source: From the Rigveda (Tryambakam Yajamahe). Recited as a meditative practice. Sample presentation.

Ritual.name: Full Moon Release Ritual
Ritual.description: A symbolic rite to release what no longer serves you at the full moon.
Ritual.source: Modern moon-cycle practice. Symbolic and reflective.

Ritual.name: Ganesh Mantra for Removing Obstacles
Ritual.description: A traditional invocation of Ganesha to clear the path before new beginnings.
Ritual.source: Traditional Hindu devotional practice invoking Ganesha (Vakratunda Mahakaya). Sample wording for demonstration.

Ritual.name: Abundance Coin Bowl Ritual
Ritual.description: A simple symbolic rite to align intention with prosperity using everyday objects.
Ritual.source: Modern symbolic practice. No historical provenance; for intention-setting only.

Ritual.name: Lakshmi Abundance Puja
Ritual.description: A symbolic prosperity practice inviting abundance through gratitude and intention.
Ritual.source: Inspired by traditional Lakshmi puja. Simplified for guided practice. Symbolic, not a guarantee of wealth.

RitualStep.title: Powerful Mantra for Ultimate Health, Wealth & Success
RitualStep.content: Transform your life with this powerful Siddha Bengali Mantra. Chant it daily to attract supreme physical energy, sharp intellect, divine blessings of Goddess Lakshmi and Saraswati, and ultimate health, wealth, and prosperity.

translations.mantra: Om Ghram Swang Hanun Vajraghranti Surya Debatay Namah Pawan Debatay Namah Mamah Shareere Oja Megh Urja Pradayanam Bhagwati Brahmsaraswati Roop Bidya Bal Buddhi Dehi Dehi Sukh Samriddhi Safalyam Pradayanam Kuru Kuru Ma Katyayani Dhan Vaibhav Aishwarya Dehi Dehi Ma Lakshmi Duhai Lagilo Bramandker Somosto Yogini Kore Pusher Borsha Duhai Mundirnather Dohai Somlota Sati
translations.title: Ultimate Health, Wealth & Success
translations.content: Take your hands in front of your eyes, chant the mantra 31 times on your both hands and blow after every chant, stand up and take your hands head to bottom 31 times then hit the floor 5 times.

translations.mantra: ॐ घ्रं स्वांग हनूँ वज्रघ्रान्ति सूर्य देबताय नमः पवन देबताय नमः ममः शरीरे ओज मेघ ऊर्जा प्रदायनम भगवती ब्रम्हसरस्वती रूप बिद्या बल बुद्धि देहि देहि सुख समृद्धि साफल्यम प्रदायनम कुरु कुरु मा कात्यायनी धन वैभव ऐश्वर्या देहि देहि मा लक्ष्मी दुहाई लागिलो ब्रामण्डकेर सोमोस्तो योगिनि कोरे पुष्पेर बोरषा दुहाई मुंडीरनाथेर दोहाई सोमलोता सतीर
translations.title: असीम ऊर्जा और समृद्धि पाने का अचूक सिद्ध मंत्र
translations.content: अपने हाथों को अपनी आँखों के सामने लाएँ, दोनों हाथों पर 31 बार मंत्र का जाप करें और हर जाप के बाद फूँक मारें, खड़े हो जाएं और अपने हाथों को सिर से पैर तक 31 बार फेरें, फिर फर्श पर 5 बार हाथ मारें।

translations.mantra: ওঁ ঘ্ৰং স্বাং হনূঁ বজ্ৰঘ্ৰান্তি সূৰ্য দেবতায় নমঃ পবন দেবতায় নমঃ মমঃ শরীরে ওজ মেঘ ঊর্জা প্রদায়নম ভগবতী ব্রদ্মসরস্বতী রূপ বিদ্যা বল বুদ্ধি দেহি দেহি সুখ সমৃদ্ধি সাফল্যম প্রদায়নম কুরু কুরু মা কাত্যায়নী ধন বৈভব ঐশ্বর্য্য দেহি দেহি মা লক্ষ্মী দোহাই লাগিলো ব্রামণ্ডকের সোমোস্ত যোগিনি কোরে পুষ্পের বোরষা দোহাই মুণ্ডীরনাথের দোহাই সোমলোতা সতীর

You have to chant the mantra 3 times and blow towards the house after every chant. At last blow 2 extra.

आपको इस मंत्र का 3 बार जाप करना है और हर जाप के बाद घर की तरफ फूंक मारनी है। अंत में 2 बार अतिरिक्त फूंक मारें।

বাঁধন করে শ্যাওলা গাছের প্রেতিনী বাঁধন করে লতাপাতা।
কার আজ্ঞায়, ব্রহ্মা-বিষ্ণুর আজ্ঞায়, সাড়ে সাত দিন
বাঁধা হয়ে থাকবে অমুকের অঙ্গে। দোহাই, হরি ঝি আজ্ঞা
চণ্ডীর পা।
translations.title: সাড়ে সাত দিনের জন্য শরীর বন্ধন করার মন্ত্র
translations.content: অমুকের জায়গায় নিজের নাম উচারণ করুন।

RitualStep.title: Protect Body for 7.5 Days
RitualStep.content: Recite this mantra 5 times and blow onto your body 5 times; then, blow onto your body two additional times. This will place a protective seal (bandhan) around your body for seven and a half days.
